description: Source code for the SimpleInstaller class managing marketplace item installation/removal, including modes, MCPs, and skills, with file system interactions and VS Code integration.

classes.name: SimpleInstaller
classes.description: Class providing methods to install and remove marketplace items such as modes, MCPs, and skills, with support for project and global targets.

methods.name: installItem
methods.description: Main method to install a marketplace item based on its type.

methods.name: installMode
methods.description: Installs a mode item, updating YAML configuration files.

methods.name: installMcp
methods.description: Installs an MCP item, updating JSON configuration files.

methods.name: installSkill
methods.description: Installs a skill by downloading and extracting its tarball.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a marketplace item based on its type.

methods.name: removeMode
methods.description: Removes a mode from custom modes via CustomModesManager.

methods.name: removeMcp
methods.description: Removes an MCP server entry from JSON configuration.

methods.name: getModeFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path for modes configuration based on target.

methods.name: getMcpFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path for MCP configuration based on target.

methods.name: getSkillsDirectoryPath
methods.description: Returns the directory path for skills based on target.
